title: DHS Office of Homeland Security Statistics: Yearbook of Immigration Statistics
agency: U.S. Department of Homeland Security, Office of Homeland Security Statistics
questions: how many green cards were issued in fiscal year 2024
lawful permanent residents by country of birth over the last decade
refugee arrivals by country of nationality
removals and returns by country of nationality
green cards so far this fiscal year by quarter

manual.how: Open https://ohss.dhs.gov/topics/immigration/yearbook, choose the fiscal year, and download the topic's data tables workbook (e.g. "Lawful Permanent Residents 2024 Data Tables (xlsx)"; FY2015-2021 are .zip files); for the quarterly report open https://ohss.dhs.gov/topics/immigration/legal-immigration-and-adjustment-status-report and download the fiscal year's .xlsx. Upload the file unchanged under the name shown in INSTRUCTIONS.md: the pack reads the requested sheet from it.

cache.why: Small published workbooks that are revised and re-posted under new names; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: Statistics published by a U.S. federal agency are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of Homeland Security, Office of Homeland Security Statistics, {dataset}, ohss.dhs.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which fiscal year? DHS counts by federal fiscal year (October to September), not calendar year; the newest yearbook is the default, and the quarterly report covers the current year with preliminary figures.
All persons obtaining LPR status, or only new arrivals from abroad (or only adjustments of status inside the U.S.)? The yearbook total counts both.
By country of birth, country of last residence, or (for refugees, asylees and the quarterly report) country of nationality? They are different tables with different counts.
